# CI configuration
name: build
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, "release/*"]
  pull_request:

env:
  NODE_VERSION: 20
  GREETING: 'hello: world'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        node: [18, 20]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Test
        run: |
          npm test
          echo "done: $?"
      - name: Folded
        run: >
          a folded
          scalar
      - name: Anchors
        with: &defaults
          retries: 3
          timeout: 1.5
        other: *defaults
anchors:
  enabled: true
  disabled: no
  nothing: ~
  date: 2026-11-10
  multi: "a
    string"
list:
  - one
  - key: value
    nested:
      - deep
---
second: document
